text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! Everyone already remembers
that way of running from the casino.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Seeking strength, learning, mastering.
That is the true attitude of one aiming for the world.
And—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—You're sayin' not to be scared of copycats, right?
Heh! Don't underestimate me!
My running ain't so fragile that anyone can just copy it!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: “You're right. The way that mindset of yours spread has allowed the entire team to grow tremendously.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This review has given us great hope for the future!
Let's carefully consider our strategy for the next season.
